Oyster Therapeutics · brandmark brainstorm, round sixteen

Fewer, bigger, deeper waves

Round fifteen with a few big undulations instead of many small lobes. Each protein’s outer edge is bent into four to six smooth waves, as deep as you like; the waves fade out near the seam and the pearl, so the two proteins still fit each other at a hairline gap and the pearl sits in a clean pocket. Fill colours are the 3D story’s. Structures: PDB 5T35, Gadd et al., Nat. Chem. Biol. 2017; the degrader is drawn generically.
